import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        public Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v; this.r = r; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
        static List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
        static int[] sz = new int[N];
        static long mc;

        static {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                sz[i] = 0;
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        static int[] par = new int[N];
        static long[] pot = new long[N];
        static long[] dist = new long[N];

        static void pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0, n, 0);
            // Bellman-Ford for potential initialization if needed
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c > 0) {
                            pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0, n, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, n, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;

            if (sparse) {
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                queue.offer(s);
                boolean[] inQueue = new boolean[n];
                inQueue[s] = true;
                while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = queue.poll();
                    inQueue[u] = false;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            if (!inQueue[e.v]) {
                                queue.offer(e.v);
                                inQueue[e.v] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Dense
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                    int u2 = -1;
                    long best = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u2 = i;
                        }
                    }
                    u = u2;
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= INF) {
                return 0;
            }
            long df = INF;
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[adj[u].get(par[u]).v]).v) {
                Edge r = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v];
                Edge e = r;
                Long minC = null;
                for (Edge edge : adj[r.v]) {
                    if (edge.r == r.r) {
                        minC = edge.c - edge.f;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                long reserve = minC != null ? minC : 0;
                df = Math.min(df, reserve);
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[adj[u].get(par[u]).v]).v) {
                Edge r = adj[adj[u].get(par[u]).v];
                Edge e = r;
                // Increase flow
                e.f += df;
                // For the reverse edge
                // Since we stored edges remain in adjacency, handle accordingly
                // For simplicity, traverse to find reverse edge
                for (Edge revEdge : adj[r.v]) {
                    if (revEdge.v == u && revEdge.r == par[adj[u].get(par[u]).v]) {
                        revEdge.f -= df;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                price[0] += df * e.p;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            pot_init(n);
            long flow = 0;
            long delta;
            while ((delta = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)) > 0) {
                flow += delta;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());

        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        Flow.init(sink + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t_iter = 0; t_iter < T; t_iter++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t_iter * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t_iter > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t_iter - 1) * n, i + t_iter * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            StringTokenizer st2 = new StringTokenizer(line);
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st2.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st2.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t_iter = 1; t_iter < T; t_iter++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t_iter - 1) * n, b + t_iter * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t_iter - 1) * n, a + t_iter * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] priceArr = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.min_cost_flow(source, sink, priceArr, sink + 1, true);
        assert flow == k;
        out.println(priceArr[0]);
        out.flush();
    }
}
